no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: GelStat Corporation has pivoted away from natural healthcare products (legacy migraine and sleep OTC products) and now operates primarily through subsidiary GSAC Engineering, providing industrial security automation (ICAS, ECD, VBEC) and renewable-energy engineering services. The company has suspended its natural-pharmaceuticals operations and has no FDA-regulated drug pipeline or clinical trials.
